2609.31908.title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
2609.31908.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.
2609.31908.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在醫學考試和問答基準上表現良好，但在需要精確數值輸出的醫學計算任務上仍然不可靠。這些計算支持高風險的決策，例如藥物劑量、器官功能評估和預後評分，因為即使是小錯誤也可能帶來嚴重的臨床後果。我們引入了MedCode，一個通過訓練LLMs生成嵌入式可執行代碼來改善醫學計算的框架。在臨床背景下，模型識別相關計算器，提取其輸入變量，並生成一個將算術運算委派給確定性解釋器的腳本。執行該腳本返回計算值及其解釋和適當的單位。我們從MedCalc基準構建了監督微調（SFT）和偏好數據集，並額外策劃了一個針對重症監護病房（ICU）場景的計算任務數據集。我們進一步提出了加權直接偏好優化（wDPO），該方法自適應地強調模型難以區分的偏好對。使用LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B的實驗顯示絕對準確率提高了20至30個百分點，證明了嵌入式代碼生成在醫學計算中的有效性。
